highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.2 delivers four more upstream m150 synchronization rounds, including targeted Ganesh fixes.

bullets.detail: Rolls up four upstream synchronization rounds for the m150 engine, including one update focused on the Ganesh GPU renderer.

v4.150.2.subtitle: Provides continued maintenance for the Skia m150 release line.
